about: Answer key for the keyed facts page facts-v1 (queue #87, W3). index.html carries known counts; tests/test_design_facts_counts.py runs the homepage workflow's own measure code on it (design_homepage_v2.write_review_inputs with page checks: design_capture.py, axe-core, design_measure.js, design_page_checks, craft metrics) and asserts that facts.md, capture.json, facts/<page>-<view>.json, craft-metrics.json and craft-facts.md report exactly these numbers. Written from the page's source before any measure ran; a mismatch is explained in ~/design-lab/homepage-workflow/wave2/W3-REPORT.md (page wrong or meter wrong), never fixed by editing this key to match a meter.

brief.audience: adults who have never thrown a pot
brief.purpose: get a beginner to book an evening class
brief.disclosure: Larkspur Clay Studio is a made-up studio for a measuring test page.

axe.about: Distinct axe rule ids failing, the same in both views, with the elements each one names.

contrast_pairs.about: Text that fails WCAG 1.4.3 in both views. P1-P4 fail on their declared colours (design_measure.js contrast_failures; ratios from the WCAG formula). P5 is white text on a dark declared background colour (17.85:1, a pass on paper) painted over a light background image, so only the pixel check sees it (design_page_checks text-over-image; behind it #f0f9ff or #e0f2fe, 1.07-1.15:1).

pairs.text: Classes run on Tuesday and Thursday evenings from six until nine.
Our two electric kilns fire to cone six.
Clay and firing fees are included. Cancel up to two days before a class for a full refund.
Open studio every Sunday afternoon, bring a friend.

small_targets.about: Targets under 24x24 px whose 24 px circles overlap (WCAG 2.5.8), in both views: four 16x16 swatch buttons 2 px apart.

text_sizes.about: Exactly nine text sizes, one weight each, so nine type styles; the same at every width (no media queries, no fluid sizes). Counts are text elements per style (design_measure.js type_styles).

must_pass.why: 28 px grey #8a8a8a on white is 3.45:1: large text needs 3:1, so neither axe nor design_measure.js may report it.
Text of a disabled button (#b8b8b8 on #f3f4f6, 1.80:1) has no contrast requirement: design_measure.js lists it under contrast_exempt, axe skips it.
Its declared colours (white on #0f172a, 17.85:1) pass: design_measure.js and axe must not count it; the pixel check alone fails it (P5).
Every other target is at least 24 px tall and wide, so the swatches are the only small targets.

also_measured.about: Other facts the page plants or implies; not part of the four keyed counts.
